sofia_cs: Heads up — IgniteCorp onboarding stalled. Their dashboard shows a spike in 95th pct latency for chat requests since Tuesday. A few trial users hit UI timeouts, and the CFO asked about cost before renewal. Can we propose something quick to reduce tail latency? :warning:
ethan_mlops: Seen the traces — long tail tied to autoregressive decode on mistral-7b with long prompts and no KV cache hits. Throughput is fine but per-request latency jumps on some sequences. Quick wins: quantize to q4_0 or q3_k_m and route heavy customers to a dedicated low-latency pool. Also consider swapping to a smaller distilled model for interactive paths.
priya_se: Agree. For IgniteCorp specifically they care about latency not absolute quality. Suggest: 1) a canary quantization (q4_0) on a subset of traffic, 2) model-swap for UI interactive routes to redwood-small-1 (fast) with fallback to mistral-7b for complex queries, 3) a short enablement session to walk their SREs through SDK knob changes. I can run the customer-facing note. :white_check_mark:
gary_sre: From ops side, we should add a routing rule and a gradual rollout. Canary window 1% -> 10% over 30m, watch 95p latency and error rate. If we hit regressions revert to previous routing. Also need to check KV cache config; enabling prefix caching for their most common prompts will cut tokens emitted.
ethan_mlops: Sample routing policy we can apply (canary):
```json
{
  "match": {"customer_id": "ignitecorp", "route": "interactive"},
  "policy": [
    {"weight": 0.01, "model": "mistral-7b-q4_0", "pool": "dedicated-lowlat-ignite"},
    {"weight": 0.99, "model": "mistral-7b", "pool": "shared"}
  ],
  "monitoring": {"metrics": ["p95_latency","error_rate"], "alert_on": {"p95_latency": ">200ms"}}
}
```
priya_se: I'll draft the customer note and schedule a 30-min enablement call tomorrow. Also plan to capture a quick feedback poll after the change (1-2 questions) to verify quality perceptions vs latency improvements.
sofia_cs: Perfect. Can you include a screenshot of dashboard baseline and the expected impact numbers? CFO will want the cost delta (quantization should cut token CPU by ~30-45%). Add a line about rollback plan.
gary_sre: I'll prepare the canary terraform patch and a rollback script. tagging @deploy-bot to spin the canary at 10:30 PT tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for IgniteCorp to start at 1718061000 (10:30 PT tomorrow). Notifying on-call if thresholds breached. :robot_face:
sofia_cs: Thanks team — I'll send the customer note after Priya shares the draft. We'll capture their feedback in the call and log it here.
